name: atr-lab-workshop
description: Plan and build a complete academic workshop for the Advanced Telerobotics Research Lab at Kent State University on any topic: an intake interview with the presenter, then a detailed outline, a run-of-show schedule, branded slides in PowerPoint and PDF with bullet speaker notes, tested hands-on code with a setup check, importable Google Forms for registration and feedback, printed flyers and a hallway TV slide. Slides and promotion are built with the atr-lab-design plugin.
